cohort: Two independent study cohorts (ITU, n = 639 and PREDO, n = 966) with samples of chorionic villus, placenta, and cord blood tissues
finding: Gestational epigenetic age acceleration or deceleration was not related to more favorable or unfavorable factors in one direction in the investigated tissues, and the relative epigenetic age differed between tissues of the same person.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was found to be a predictive factor for epigenetic age deviations.
